# Dr. Tiran Rothman

> Official website of Dr. Tiran Rothman, economist, investor, behavioral finance researcher, author, speaker and strategic advisor.

## Canonical identity
- Name: Dr. Tiran Rothman
- Hebrew: ד״ר טיראן רוטמן
- Official website: https://tiranrothman.com/
- Based in: Israel; works internationally
- Core topics: behavioral finance, behavioral economics, startup valuation, venture capital, investment strategy, financial markets, economic expert opinions, board strategy
